## Checklist

- [ ] I did not commit build artifacts (`build/`, `DerivedData/`, `.app`, `.zip`).
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, certificates, provisioning profiles, or `.env` files.
- [ ] I did not add anything that collects or transmits user data (see [PRIVACY_POLICY.md](../PRIVACY_POLICY.md)).
- [ ] `project.yml` was edited rather than `Switchly.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` (the project file is generated by XcodeGen).
- [ ] If I changed `project.yml`, I re-ran `make bootstrap`.
- [ ] If I changed `Resources/Info.plist`, the permission usage descriptions are still present.
- [ ] If I added a service or changed a model, I covered it with unit tests.
- [ ] No user-facing strings were hardcoded without adding them to `Resources/*.lproj/Localizable.strings`.
